recognize_zh: 低倍視野中有大量小淋巴球，核深染、細胞質少，許多細胞在一端或兩端拖出極性的細胞質突起（polar villous projections），並夾雜很多粉紫色的破碎塗抹細胞（smudge cells）；小 B 淋巴球帶極性絨毛，是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤（SMZL）的典型血片。
features: Absolute lymphocytosis of small lymphocytes with round to oval, dense, clumped nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Many lymphocytes show short polar (unipolar or bipolar) cytoplasmic projections giving a tailed or spindle outline
No circumferential hairy projections and no prominent nucleoli
Numerous smudge cells scattered across the field
Normocytic red cells with scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. A substantial proportion of the lymphocytes display short polar cytoplasmic villous projections, and numerous smudge cells are present. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with a small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder with villous lymphocytes, suggestive of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; flow cytometry (CD5-, CD10-, CD103-, CD25-/+ with CD11c variable) and splenic/marrow histology are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells are larger with abundant pale cytoplasm and fine circumferential hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei, with CD103+ CD25+ CD11c+ CD123+ and BRAF V600E, and HCL rarely presents with high lymphocytosis.
CLL also has many smudge cells, but its cells are round without polar villi and are CD5+ CD23+ with dim surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma / hairy cell leukemia variant
ddx.vs: These show broad-based villous projections distributed around the cell and, in HCL-variant, prominent nucleoli, with CD103 positivity in HCL-variant and red pulp rather than white pulp splenic infiltration.
MCL cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei without villi and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 and t(11;14).
